description: Remove exactly one global or project-level EASY CODE Skill after checking its version. Its directory is archived for recovery.

propertyDescriptions.scope: Exact global or project scope of the Skill to delete.
propertyDescriptions.name: Exact Skill name within the selected scope; wildcards are not accepted.
propertyDescriptions.expectedVersion: 64-character version hash returned by read_skill before deletion.

guidance: Delete a Skill only on a clear user request. Read it first to obtain the current version and show the exact scope and name in the approval.
